newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH SET TO SIGN KINDER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH SET TO SIGN KINDER.

text.p: English premier league club Middlesbrough look set to add to their long list of foreign imports this week by signing Slovakian player of the year Vladimir Kinder for one million pounds ($1.7 million) from Slovan Bratislava.
The 27-year-old international left-back has been offered a four-year contract after impressing the club during a trial.
Despite all the speculation surrounding some of their current foreign stars such as unsettled Brazilian Emerson, Boro have clearly not been off going overseas in a bid to strengthen their squad.
Boro boss Bryan Robson said: "Kinder is an experienced international who has played in Europe for his club."
Kinder should be available for his debut in January.
